points.en: Human Development shifts focus from GDP growth to people-centric progress.
points.hi: Human Development shifts focus from GDP growth to people-centric progress.

points.en: Mahbub ul Haq and Amartya Sen are the pioneers of the Human Development Index (HDI).
points.hi: Mahbub ul Haq and Amartya Sen are the pioneers of the Human Development Index (HDI).

points.en: Three pillars: Long and healthy life, knowledge, and a decent standard of living.
points.hi: Three pillars: Long and healthy life, knowledge, and a decent standard of living.

points.en: Income Approach: Oldest method, equates development with income growth.
points.hi: Income Approach: Oldest method, equates development with income growth.

points.en: Welfare Approach: Views humans as beneficiaries of government development programs.
points.hi: Welfare Approach: Views humans as beneficiaries of government development programs.

points.en: Basic Needs Approach: Focuses on health, education, food, water, sanitation, and housing.
points.hi: Basic Needs Approach: Focuses on health, education, food, water, sanitation, and housing.

points.en: Capability Approach: Associated with Amartya Sen; focuses on expanding human choices and freedoms.
points.hi: Capability Approach: Associated with Amartya Sen; focuses on expanding human choices and freedoms.

explanation.en: Health (Life expectancy), Education (Knowledge), Living Standard (GNI per capita), and Participation (Capabilities).
explanation.hi: Health (Life expectancy), Education (Knowledge), Living Standard (GNI per capita), and Participation (Capabilities).

question.en: Who introduced the concept of Human Development?
question.hi: Who introduced the concept of Human Development?

answer.en: Mahbub ul Haq and Amartya Sen.
answer.hi: Mahbub ul Haq and Amartya Sen.

misconception.en: Economic growth and Human Development are the same.
misconception.hi: Economic growth and Human Development are the same.

correction.en: Economic growth is a means to an end; Human Development is the end goal focusing on quality of life.
correction.hi: Economic growth is a means to an end; Human Development is the end goal focusing on quality of life.

fiveFacts.en: It uses geometric mean for calculation.
fiveFacts.hi: It uses geometric mean for calculation.

fiveFacts.en: India's rank is monitored in the annual HDR.

threeTraps.en: Confusing HDI with GDP per capita.
threeTraps.hi: Confusing HDI with GDP per capita.

threeTraps.en: Assuming higher income always leads to higher HDI.
threeTraps.hi: Assuming higher income always leads to higher HDI.

threeTraps.en: Ignoring the role of institutional quality in development.
